dependencies.basis: IMF e-GDDS DQAF metadata for Azerbaijan Balance of Payments states that the data are compiled following the classifications and definitions of the sixth edition of the IMF’s Balance of Payments Manual (BPM6).
dependencies.evidence_quote: The data are compiled following the classifications and definitions of the six edition of the IMF’s "Balance of Payments Manual" (BPM6). Accordingly, the standard components are classified by the following main categories: current account, capital account, financial account and reserve assets. ... The balance of payments is compiled according to BPM6 standards starting from 1 quarter of 2013 year...

dependencies.basis: IMF SDDS Summary Methodology for Armenia Balance of Payments states that BOP operations are classified in accordance with the requirements of the Balance of Payments Manual, Sixth Edition (BPM6).
dependencies.evidence_quote: BOP operations are classified in accordance with the requirements of the Balance of Payments Manual, Sixth Edition (BPM6). ... Quarterly and annual BOP data are disseminated an analytical format or on the basis of standard components, in accordance with the requirements of the IMF Balance of Payments Manual, Sixth Edition (BPM6).

dependencies.basis: Official Kazakhstan CPI methodology documentation states that the distribution of items of consumer expenditures is made according to the Classification of Individual Consumption by Purpose (COICOP), developed by the OECD and recommended as an international standard (implemented via the national NCIPC classifier aligned with COICOP).
dependencies.evidence_quote: The distribution of items of consumer expenditures of the population into groups and sections is made according to the Classification of Individual Consumption by Purpose (COICOP), developed by the Organization for Economic Cooperation and Development and recommended for use as an international standard.
